records.abstract: IntroductionNardostachys jatamansi DC. is a valued herb in traditional Chinese medicine, historically used to regulate qi flow, alleviate pain, and enhance digestive function. records.title: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau: Climate change, human activity, and plant diversity.
records.authors: Yang Y, Chen J, Song B, Zhang Y, Niu Y, Jiang Z, Sun H.
records.abstract: As the highest and largest plateau in the world, the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP) covers wide geological, topographical and climatic gradients and thus acts as a major center for biodiversity and houses a diverse array of high elevation ecosystems. Together these factors make the QTP a critical ecological shield for Asia. However, the composition, structure and function of plant diversity in QTP has experienced profound changes in recent decades. records.title: The impact of climate change on medicinal plants and natural products: A scoping review.
records.authors: Takubessi MI, Jalil B, Heinrich M.
records.abstract: BackgroundMedicinal plants and natural products are essential for healthcare systems globally, and, at the same time, they are a part of ecosystems and have major socioeconomic importance in many regions of the world. records.authors: Yang X, Liang Y, Liu P, Song L, Gao J.

An ultrasonic-assisted extraction method was developed, with the critical optimum parameters determined as follows: ultrasonic temperature at 64 °C, solid-liquid ratio of 1:45, and ultrasonic time of 52 min.
